title: RNA-seq of CD56+ NK cells from juvenile systemic lupus erythematosus (JSLE) patients and healthy controls
description: Transcriptional profiling of peripheral blood CD56+ natural killer cells from active JSLE patients, patients with low disease activity and healthy controls.

samples.title: Sample 11
samples.description: Protocols: Peripheral blood was obtained by venipuncture, followed by PBMC isolation via Ficoll gradient. Cells were frozen in liquid nitrogen until use. Thawed PBMCs were sorted using FACS to select CD3-CD14-CD56+ NK cells. PicoPure RNA extraction kit as per manufacturer's protocol NEBNext® Single Cell/Low Input RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina

runs.experiment_title: NextSeq 2000 sequencing: RNA-seq of CD56+ NK cells from juvenile systemic lupus erythematosus (JSLE) patients and healthy controls
